blocks.text: What is an online medical certificate for office sick leave?

An online medical certificate for office sick leave is a note from a registered doctor stating that you were unfit for work on the dates shown, issued after a remote consultation instead of a clinic visit. The note records the doctor's view of your fitness for work. The note is not a treatment plan, a prescription or proof for an insurance claim or legal case.
On DrCertificate, the matching choice is the Medical Certificate Sick Leave option, which covers both work and university. A general medical certificate also uses the Sick Leave option.

People mix this note up with three others. A work from home certificate says you can work, just not from the office, and has its own option on the form. A medical fitness certificate says you are fit for a job, sport or travel. An Unfit to Travel certificate covers trips, not office absence.
When do you need a medical certificate for office sick leave?

items: You need a medical certificate for office sick leave when your employer's policy asks for proof that an absence was caused by illness. The point at which a note becomes required differs by company, so the staff handbook is the first place to look.

HR is usually the team that asks. A line manager may ask too. Students hear the same request from a university office after missed classes or an exam, and an airline or travel provider may want a note when you were too unwell to fly.

Why do organisations ask at all? A medical note turns an unexplained absence into recorded sick leave, which protects your pay and your leave balance. The note also leaves a record if the leave is audited or disputed later. In Singapore, the Ministry of Manpower says that to qualify for paid sick leave, an employee must be certified unfit for work by a medical practitioner registered under the Medical Registration Act or Dental Registration Act.
Rules like that explain why HR checks who signed your note and not only whether you have one. Employers elsewhere in the region apply their own versions of the same idea.

blocks.text: Who issues an online medical certificate for office sick leave?

Independent doctors with an MBBS, MD or MS qualification review and issue every DrCertificate certificate. DrCertificate is the platform that connects you with those doctors. The platform does not diagnose, treat or prescribe, and the decision to issue rests with the doctor alone.
Every doctor on the platform is registered with a medical council.

One point matters for Singapore. The Ministry of Manpower ties paid sick leave to certification by a practitioner registered under the Medical Registration Act or Dental Registration Act. If your employer applies that rule to your claim, ask HR whether an online note from a doctor registered with another medical council will be accepted, and get the answer before you pay.
Employees in Malaysia, the Philippines and the other served countries should ask the same question in their own setting.

What should a medical certificate for office sick leave include?

A medical certificate for office sick leave usually shows your full name, the dates you were unfit for work, the purpose of the note and the details of the doctor who issued it. HR uses those details to match the note to your leave record.
Your employer may have its own format.

Check the staff handbook or ask HR before you apply. A DrCertificate certificate cannot be corrected once issued unless the fault came from the medical team, so the details you type into the form need to be right the first time.

blocks.text: Will your employer or school accept an online medical certificate for office sick leave?

Acceptance of an online medical certificate is decided by the organisation that receives it, not by the doctor or by DrCertificate. Your employer, school or airline applies its own policy and can question any note.

The same principle shows up across sectors. The UK Civil Aviation Authority says most airlines have medical advisors who clear passengers as fit to fly, and that the final decision whether to carry a passenger belongs to the airline.
DrCertificate certificates are not for submission in India, yet the lesson travels well: HR looks at what is on the page.

A note gets questioned for plain reasons. The wrong type was chosen. A detail is missing, or the name does not match HR records. Or the employer only accepts notes from a panel clinic or a locally registered doctor.
If HR questions your certificate, ask for the reason in writing and what would satisfy them. If the policy rules out online notes, an in person clinic visit is the better route.
When is an online medical certificate for office sick leave not the right choice?

An online medical certificate for office sick leave is not the right choice when you need urgent care, when the use falls outside the service rules or when you do not qualify. The doctor may also decline any request.
Doctors decline about 2% of requests, mostly when the name and ID do not match or the symptoms and details shared are inconsistent.
The service is for suitable non emergency situations only. Chest pain, difficulty breathing, confusion or symptoms that keep getting worse need in person or emergency care straight away.
DrCertificate certificates are not for submission in India. Nor are the certificates for legal purposes, and they must never be used for insurance. Applicants must be at least 16.
Recovery and caretaker certificates are not offered.

Frequently asked questions about an online medical certificate for office sick leave
Can an online medical certificate for office sick leave be backdated?

Do not count on a backdated certificate. The doctor reviews your request at the time of the chat consultation and decides which dates, if any, your details support. Apply as soon as you feel unwell, and tell HR when you applied if your absence began a day or two earlier.
How many days of sick leave can the certificate cover?

In most South East Asian countries, sick leave and work from home notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms. The doctor decides the number of days case by case after reading your details. For a longer illness, see a doctor in person who can examine you and follow up.
Do I have to talk to the doctor?

Yes, by chat only. DrCertificate uses a digital chat consultation, and the doctor may message you with follow up questions before deciding. There are no video calls or in person appointments. Keep an eye on your messages after you apply, because quick replies help the doctor reach a decision sooner.
What happens if the doctor declines my request?

If the doctor declines, no certificate is issued and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests, mostly when the name and ID do not match or the symptoms shared are inconsistent. Check your details before paying, and see a doctor in person if you still need a note.
Is a work from home certificate the same as a sick leave certificate?

No. A work from home certificate says you can work but should not go into the office, while a sick leave certificate says you were unfit for work. Pick the option HR has agreed to, because a certificate cannot be corrected once issued unless the medical team made the error.
Can I use a DrCertificate certificate for office leave in India?
No. DrCertificate certificates are not for submission in India. DrCertificate serves people in 10 South East Asian countries, and its certificates are also not for legal purposes or insurance.
